Resolves #5705

`learn/gettingstarted/Setup.md` now covers the three points of #5705 that were still missing. It states the Node.js 24 minimum (the `engines` field of `neo.mjs`). It says that `npx` runs the published `neo-app` package, so nobody clones or installs `neomjs/create-app`. It links create-app's script options and names what they choose.

Evidence: L1 (docs; each sentence checked against its source) → L1 required. Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: docs — two paragraphs of one existing page, no new page and no navigation change.

## AC Evidence

| Point of #5705 | Evidence |
|---|---|
| node and npm come as one bundle | The prerequisite now reads "Node.js 24 or newer, with npm", noting that the installer brings npm. |
| minimum versions | `package.json` `engines.node` is `>=24.0.0` at `dev` 1fe7dcab73. |
| `npx neo-app` options, pointing at the repo | Links `neomjs/create-app#script-options`. The options named (`-w`, `-n`, `-t`, `-m`, `--no-agent`, `-s`) are the ones `tasks/neo-app.mjs` declares. |
| do not `npm install` the create-app repo | Stated beside the command. |
| drop "a good idea to npm i inside the workspace" | Already gone before this PR (premise read on #5705, 2026-11-05). |
